articles.title: JPMorgan brings JPM Coin, representing dollar deposits, to Ethereum
articles.snippet: JPMorgan's dollar deposit token is heading to Ethereum as the lender looks to offer it to wider selection of institutional clients.

articles.title: SEC tokenized stock framework faces issuer pushback as Broadcom, Verizon object to OKX-ICE listing
articles.snippet: Eight more companies objected to trading on the planned OKX-ICE venue, while Nasdaq has separately said it would opt out under the SEC’s framework.

articles.title: Revolut secures Gibraltar crypto license to support global expansion
articles.snippet: The UK-based fintech will use the authorization to offer crypto services in additional international markets, though it has not disclosed specific countries or launch dates.

articles.title: BingX, YouHodler added to ESMA MiCA register in latest update
articles.snippet: ESMA’s latest MiCA register update includes BingX, YouHodler and Banco Santander’s Openbank, bringing the total to 375 unique CASPs.

articles.title: Cysic crypto bridge halted after unauthorized mint of 10M CYS
articles.snippet: Cysic said the incident was limited to bridge message processing and minting and did not affect the mainnet or other operational systems.
